name: Reviews
tagline: Ask happy customers for a review at the right moment

roadmap.note: Needs a completed job or appointment to trigger from, so it follows Bookings and Quotes.

marketing.summary: The best time to ask for a review is just after the work is done and the customer is pleased. Reviews watches for that moment - a completed booking, an accepted quote - and asks, then shows the results on your site.
marketing.audience: Local businesses that live or die by their star rating and never remember to ask.

features.title: Triggered by real events
features.body: Asks after a completed appointment or finished job, not on an arbitrary schedule.

features.title: Ask once, politely
features.body: One reminder, then it stops. Nagging costs you the review and the customer.

features.title: Show them on your site
features.body: An embeddable wall of reviews using the same one-line snippet as the assistant.

faq.a: No. Filtering unhappy customers away from public review sites breaks Google's policies and is not something we will build.
